items.text: Pages & Categories usage columns — Config → Pages and Categories match Tags: column headers (name / Usage / Actions), popularity bar + bookmark count, tier styling from relative usage.

Help tab surface (B5) — Config → Help uses the shared config-tab-surface shell: intro paragraph, filter toolbar with clear button, Quick links index + help sections as divided rows inside one card (Classic, Modern, and Glass).
Tab group unsaved dot (C14) — when a tab inside a group has unsaved changes, the group label shows a dot (e.g. System ● when General is dirty).
Reduced-motion chrome (C15) — with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, config tab transitions, scroll-hint pulse, unsaved-badge pulse, and save-status spinner animations are disabled.
Stats guided tour paused — the Stats tab spotlight tour is temporarily disabled; the Show Stats tour again reset button is hidden until the tour is re-enabled.
Config → Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — What's new recap and General help document v2026.07.01.4 (usage columns, Help surface, unsaved group dots, reduced motion, Stats tour off).
README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG — release notes for v2026.07.01.4; Playwright config suite extended for Help surface (B5), group unsaved dot (C14), and reduced-motion chrome (C15).
